verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations on the user's behalf under role-based permissions, which enables natural-language/agentic control via an AI agent interface rather than the product itself exposing an NL command layer. Missing for 10: direct evidence of a native natural-language command interface within Sumsub's own UI/API, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's real-world usability.
